name: all-systems-go
description: Cross-system finance workflows, named for airCFO's All Systems Go series on the startup back-office stack. Connects Stripe, Ramp, and Mercury (each read-only with your own login) and adds workflows that read your Finance Brain first: runway & burn, revenue reconciliation, board metrics, plus meta-skills to author and refine your own. Pairs with the free Finance Brain Starter Kit. Unofficial: not affiliated with or endorsed by Stripe, Ramp, Mercury, Intuit, or Anthropic.
